callerAudit.finding: The only runtime reader selected the retired external tmux branch. All declarations, transport fields and internal callers in that branch are removed; only regression inputs retain the names.

runLegacyCutover had no production caller or concrete action adapter. The remaining exports belonged solely to the uncalled preflight script and their dedicated tests. The entire isolated module and its five tests were removed.

reviewFixExternalConfiguration.finding: Preserve writable host tmux binds for explicit external installations without a migration completion marker.
reviewFixExternalConfiguration.implementation: Resolve the existing host endpoint for either a completed migration or LLV_LEGACY_TMUX_EXTERNAL=1. Never create a marker or control the tmux server.
